rawFamilyEvidence.sup7_note_9: In general, traffic signs are to comprise of 2mm thick aluminum sheets. However, 3mm thick aluminium sheets must be used for the following signs: a) Traffic signs of size 900mm x 900mm. b) 'Directional Arrows' signs of size 600mm x 150mm. c) Signs erected at height clearance less than 2.2m such as 'Sharp Deviation', 'Keep Left / Right' and 'Pass Either Side' or d) Street name board installed on walls or bus shelters.
